layers.summary: The universal layer keeps project knowledge portable across tools: overview, architecture, ADRs, constraints, risks, acceptance criteria, tasks, milestones, prompts, and codebase index files.

Structure, symbol, and dependency indexes for fast codebase orientation.

layers.name: Agent-specific layer
layers.summary: Each target adapter owns its own filenames and formatting so contributors can open the result in the tool they already use without translation work.

entries.description: Writes a thin CLAUDE.md index, PLAN.md, and the .claude workspace when the two-layer scaffold is enabled.

Creates goose-context.json so Block's Goose can ingest structured tasks and constraints.
